verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's own docs point to voice capabilities: Discord voice support with voice transcripts and meeting notes, and release notes saying it can 'use GPT Live in meetings and calls', which suggests live voice conversation. The evidence is only page titles and one-line release-note fragments, with no detail on how these work. Missing for 10: documented voice-note transcription on messaging channels (e.g. WhatsApp/Telegram), spoken/TTS replies, in-depth docs on live voice conversation setup and behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can interact by voice — voice notes get transcribed, replies can be spoken, or live voice conversations are supported
